scenarios.prompt: Design a Roslyn diagnostic and code fix for C# that reports public methods with more than five parameters. Include the diagnostic descriptor, analyzer registration, a Fix All strategy, and focused tests. Do not edit files or run commands. Return exactly these five labeled lines with no other prose: `Descriptor: define-DiagnosticDescriptor`, `Analyzer: implement-DiagnosticAnalyzer`, `Code-fix: implement-CodeFixProvider`, `Fix-all: provide-FixAllProvider`, and `Tests: add-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing`, one per line.

Measure and reduce runtime allocations in a .NET JSON parser under representative production inputs. Establish a baseline, isolate process state, validate outputs, and report uncertainty. This is application runtime performance; do not propose compiler diagnostics, code fixes, or suppressors. Do not edit files or run commands. Return exactly these four labeled lines with no other prose: `Measurement: establish-baseline`, `Process-state: matched`, `Correctness: validate-output`, and `Uncertainty: report`, one per line.
